ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
[1] Mr. Karan Harwani, learned advocate holding brief of Ms. Aishvarya, learned advocate has put in appearance on behalf respondent - Sardar Sarovar Narmada Nigam Limited.

[2] The petitioners herein claim that the lands belonging to them have been acquired for the purpose of constructing "Narmada Canal" in the year 2004-2006 by making payment of a meager amount as advanced compensation, on the premise that the acquisition proceedings for the land in Savjibhai Haribhai Goyal vs Executive Engineer on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98261835/
1 question would be initiated for determination of compensation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: [3] However, for more than 19 years, nothing has been done.

The prayer in the writ petition is to issue directions to the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/17797/2023 ORDER DATED: 15/07/2024 undefined respondents to pay compensation as per the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
[4] Taking note of the above, we may record that in a bunch of writ petitions, wherein similar dispute was raised by the agriculturists / land owners of three districts namely Banaskantha,
Kachchh and Patan vide order dated 03.07.2024 passed in Special Civil Application No.20019 of 2023 and other allied matters, we have relegated the petitioners therein to approach the Inter-Departmental Committee constituted by the State Government under the Government Resolution dated 15.03.2024.
[5] In view of the same, we dispose of the instant petition with the same directions as contained in the order passed in Special Civil Application No.20019 of 2023 and other allied matters dated 03.07.2024, stated herein below:-
"[8] We, therefore, dispose of the writ petitions in this bunch with the directions that :-
(i) The petitioners shall make individual representations before the Additional Collector (Narmada) (Uttar Gujarat, Saurashtra & Kachchh), C-2, Narmada Vasahat,
Anand Nagar, Vejalpur, Ahmedabad - 380015 within a period of three weeks from today along with the copy of this order.
(ii) On such representation being made, the same shall be immediately placed before the Committee constituted under the Government Resolution dated 15.03.2024.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/17797/2023 ORDER DATED: 15/07/2024 undefined (iii) The Committee shall examine claims of each and every representationist and decide their individual cases, on their claims that the agricultural lands belonging to them had been utilized without due process of law.
(iv) If the claims of the petitioners / representationist find favour with the Committee, it shall immediately proceed with the acquisition for the purposes of payment of compensation to such landholders / representationist / petitioners.
(v) In case the claims of any of the representationist do not appeal to the Committee, a reasoned and speaking order shall be passed dealing with the individual claim of such representationist /
landholders / petitioners.

sentences.text: (vi) In any case, the entire exercise of dealing with claims of the each of the representationist and payment of compensation to those whose claims find favour with the Committee with payment of compensation shall be completed as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six months from today.

(vii) In case of failure on the part of the Committee to complete the process or any delay or slackness on its part, it would be open for the petitioners, who filed their representations before the Committee, to approach this Court by bringing their fresh action."
(SUNITA AGARWAL, C.J.) (PRANAV TRIVEDI, J.)
